message: All four production CUDA thermal/PTE scenarios passed, followed by fixed-Maxwell-Q thermal-material AD-FD at the grown/grown and evaporated/evaporated interface endpoints. The 201x201 coarse nodal-to-200x200 thermal-cell mapping has worst transpose error 1.811e-15. Thermal-material directional errors are 2.229e-6 (grown/grown, h=0.0025) and 1.119e-5 (evaporated/evaporated, h=0.005). The original grown/grown fail JSON is immutable and preserved; its failure was only an obsolete over-strict mapping-FD classification. Combined Maxwell AD-FD and design-window selection still block optimization.
